# v2026.10.27

<!-- Written by scripts/release/changelog.mjs from CHANGELOG/2026.10.27.md. Do not edit it: the release cut writes it again. -->

AI agents and tools can read these release notes as [plain Markdown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arcforgelabs/flow/main/CHANGELOG/2026.10.27.md).

This release covers **5 pull requests.**

## Highlights

- Jobs reach a Ready to invoice stage, and automations draft their invoices by rule. ([#77](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/77))
- A lab builds its own invoice rules (When, If, Then). ([#89](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/89))
- Invoices have Drafts, Problem and Ready tabs, and one button sends all ready invoices. ([#91](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/91))
- Errors and problem reports go to the installation's own Sentry project. ([#83](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/83))

## Changes

- Sentry integration sends errors and problem reports to each installation's own Sentry project. ([#83](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/83))
- Ready-to-invoice stage, automations, drafts by rule, and two Xero send modes. ([#77](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/77))
- Invoice rules a lab builds (When, If, Then). ([#89](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/89))
- Drafts, Problem and Ready invoices, Mark ready, and one button to send all ready invoices. ([#91](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/91))
